content.name: Subgraph Diagnosis Example
content.summary: Offline structural example of peer subgraphs, delegation and node-local results

aisop.main:
graph TD
    intake[Read] --> diagnose[aisop.diagnose]
    diagnose --> reply[Reply]
    reply --> end_node((End))
aisop.diagnose:
graph TD
    gather_info[Gather] --> analyze[Analyze]
    analyze --> diagnose_done((Done))

intake.step1: Read user_input as the text to inspect

diagnose.step1: Prepare the permitted context for the diagnosis subgraph

gather_info.step1: Make request_text available through the permitted program context
gather_info.step3: Use the node-local keywords list to prepare evidence

rank.step1: Rank keyword_candidates by relevance and produce an ordered list

keywords_done.step1: Return the ordered list in keywords_output as the extract_keywords business completion output

analyze.step1: Use gathered_evidence to produce a short diagnosis

diagnose_done.step1: Return diagnosis_result as the diagnose business completion output

end_node.step1: Present the final response before the main graph completes
